subtitle: Markdown drafts with reviewed GitHub saves
description: Write Markdown with the Rinx article editor in a compatible OctoSense host. Recover local drafts after restart; connect GitHub through host OAuth, choose a repository and file, and review exact Markdown before saving. Requires a host with contract 1.8.0 / GitHub publisher support and the native Markdown editor; beta.2 cannot install this keyless release. Live GitHub OAuth and remote commits remain unverified. Optional Ask GitHub Notes requires separate agent consent and may send questions, context and permitted repository reads to your configured model. No agent write or approval tools are exposed; manual editing works without a model.
release_notes: 0.2.1: clarify that the GitHub release workflow does not grant App Hub admission and supports an issue opened before the release. Regenerate from Design Flow a9a07f4. Editor, permissions and draft format remain unchanged. Verified 0.2.0 installed editing/restart evidence is recorded separately; this update uses a fresh immutable attestation.
